title: podman: Validate format flags before performing operations
body:
Previously, commands could perform their operations before reporting an invalid `--format` value. For example, container mount could mount a container, image mount could mount an image, and generate systemd could write a service file before returning an error.

This change validates format arguments before performing the operation, preventing these unintended side effects.

One behaviour change is that `podman container mount --format=bogus <name>` now returns an error instead of silently ignoring the format and succeeding when a container name is provided.

Adds tests to verify that invalid format values do not result in mounts or generated files. The tests cover container mount, image mount, and systemd generation.

Fixes: #30275
